errors.text: The hypothesis does not make the required definite net prediction that SRO increases lattice thermal conductivity; it allows a plateau, inflection, or increase and gives no expected magnitude.
The cited evidence establishes SRO or segregation in W-Ta-Cr-V-Hf systems but does not support a percolation-induced thermal-conductivity increase or the proposed phonon mechanism.

The experiment measures total thermal conductivity in a metallic alloy without a clear procedure for separating lattice and electronic contributions, so it cannot directly verify the claimed phonon-transport mechanism.
